description: This file implements the 'Library' class, which manages dynamic library loading, symbol resolution, reference counting, and unloading for the Thunder project. It includes platform-specific code for Windows and Linux to handle shared libraries and provides mechanisms for safe resource management.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: A class that encapsulates dynamic library handling, including loading, symbol resolution, reference counting, and unloading.

methods.name: Library()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty library handle.

methods.name: Library(const void* functionInLibrary)
methods.description: Constructs a Library object by obtaining a handle to the library containing the specified function pointer.

methods.name: Library(const TCHAR fileName[])
methods.description: Constructs a Library object by loading a library from the specified filename.

methods.name: Library(const Library& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor that increases the reference count.

methods.name: Library(Library&& move)
methods.description: Move constructor transferring ownership of the library handle.

methods.name: ~Library()
methods.description: Destructor that releases the library handle.

methods.name: operator=(const Library& RHS)
methods.description: Copy assignment operator that manages reference counting.

methods.name: LoadFunction(const TCHAR functionName[])
methods.description: Loads a function symbol from the loaded library.

methods.name: WaitUnloaded(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Waits until the library is unloaded or timeout occurs.

methods.name: AddRef()
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the library handle.

methods.name: Release()
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and unloads the library if count reaches zero.
